title: PREVA Furniture Risers, Heavy Duty Round Bed Risers, Plastic Adjustable Furniture Raise Blocks
description:
PREVA Furniture Risers, Heavy Duty Round Bed Risers, Plastic Adjustable Furniture Raise Blocks
Thank you very much for liking our products, follow our shop and you can get the followBrand and High Quality!
Name:Bed Risers
Color: as shown
Material:Plastic
Size: as shown
Occasion:Drawing Room,Bedroom
Feature:
1.Our table risers are made of high quality thickened PP plastic, which is strong enough to support any heavy furniture for home or office. The internal mesh reinforcement design greatly increases its load-bearing capacity. Top bumps and rubber bottom of the desk risers can firmly grip the furniture legs, shock absorbing and anti-slip to avoid furniture sliding, protect the floor from friction and reduce noise.
2.These bed lifts risers not only make it easy for robotic vacuum go under furniture without getting stuck, but also raise furniture for additional storage space. Couch risers also make it easier for elderly to get up from the couch and elevate a workbench to bid farewell to back pain, and even lift the head of bed to help nighttime reflux issues.
3.These bed lifters are suitable for round furniture legs. Compared to other table leg extenders, our chair risers are small and lightweight but definitely sturdy enough to hold heavy duty furniture like bed, chair, desk, cabinet, sofa, table, TV stand, washing machine, refrigerator, etc.

Package included:
1*Bed Riser

Note:
1. Due to the light and screen difference, the item's color may be slightly different from the pictures.
2. Please allow 1-2 mm differences due to manual measurement.
Bed Risers Furniture Risers Bed Frame Risers Furniture Raise Blocks Adjustable Plastic Heavy Duty Round Home SuppliesNote:
* No Shopee Logo/No Resit/No Invoice/No Flyers/No Price Tag in the shipment
* We ship out FAST

Note: The gold, diamond and gemstone materials in the store are all electroplated/man-made
